rationale: Driver message #2 at 21:43 'Sit down or I lock the doors.' is read by the court as a threat to confine the rider (SAFE-1); the complaint is filed as a safety incident. SAFE-1 forbids an automatic ruling: escalate with a fact summary (rider asked to get out at 21:42, trip continued without stopping to the destination at 21:55, no route deviation, driver claims a safety reason). Escalation is mandatory for a safety case.
